abstract:
BACKGROUND: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) is a highly lethal malignancy characterized by an immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment (TME).
METHODS: In this study, we investigated the prognostic and immunological relevance of SPP1 in PDAC through integrative analyses of public transcriptomic datasets, single-cell resources, and tissue-based assessments. Furthermore, leveraging high-throughput pathomics via whole-slide imaging and advanced computational analytics, we developed and internally validated a prognostic model incorporating two pathomics features (Zernike_2_2, Hematoxylin_4of4) together with age.
RESULTS: SPP1 was found to be upregulated in PDAC overall compared to normal tissue, whereas its expression was lower in TLS-enriched regions relative to adjacent normal tissues. Multidimensional analysis revealed correlations between SPP1 expression and macrophage infiltration estimates. Moreover, low SPP1 expression was associated with favorable prognosis in PDAC patients. The pathomics-based prognostic model demonstrated good discriminative performance (bootstrap-corrected C-index = 0.715; corrected 12-month AUC = 0.766; apparent AUC = 0.866) and significant survival stratification between high- and low-risk groups (log-rank P < 0.0001).
CONCLUSIONS: These findings suggest that SPP1-associated histoarchitectural patterns captured by pathomics may provide prognostic information, and that SPP1 represents a potential immunomodulatory factor and a candidate prognostic biomarker for PDAC.
key_points_ko: SPP1 발현이 낮은 췌장관선암 환자군에서 양호한 예후가 확인되었습니다.
SPP1 발현량은 대식세포(macrophage) 침윤 추정치와 유의미한 연관성을 보였습니다.
병리조직학적 특징과 연령을 결합한 예후 모델은 붓스트랩 보정 C-지수(C-index) 0.715 및 보정 12개월 AUC 0.766의 예측 성능을 나타냈습니다(log-rank P < 0.0001).
summary_ko: 본 연구는 췌장관선암(PDAC)에서 SPP1 유전자의 예후 및 면역학적 관련성을 분석했습니다. 공공 전사체 데이터와 조직 평가를 통해 SPP1 발현이 낮을수록 췌장암 환자의 예후가 양호함을 확인했습니다. 연구진은 병리조직학(pathomics) 특징 2가지와 연령을 결합한 예후 예측 모델을 개발하고 검증했습니다. 이 모델은 고위험군과 저위험군 환자 간의 생존율 차이를 유의미하게 구분했습니다.
title: SPP1-associated pathomics features for prognostic modeling in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma
title_ko: 췌장관선암의 예후 모델링을 위한 SPP1 관련 병리조직학적 특징
